items.title: Anthropic commits $10 million to Canadian AI research
items.summary: Anthropic is committing $10M to Canadian research institutions to fund the next generation of AI research.

items.title: Singapore office and government MOU | Anthropic
items.summary: Anthropic opens its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signs an MOU with the government on AI safety, evaluation, and responsible adoption.

items.title: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
items.summary: Anthropic is launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.

items.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
items.summary: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

items.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
items.summary: Claude Frontier Academy trains Frontier Deployed Engineers to the standard of Anthropic’s own — a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 by the end of 2027.

items.title: Investing in the public benefit
items.summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

items.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.summary: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement. items.title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
items.summary: We’re shortening our vulnerability disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all other issues.

items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.summary: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.

items.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
items.summary: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.

items.title: AI agents find smart contract exploits
items.summary: On a benchmark of real exploited contracts, AI agents found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, underscoring the need for AI-powered defense.

items.title: Claude does cyber competitions
items.summary: Throughout 2025, we quietly entered Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed for humans. It often placed in the top 25% of competitors.

items.title: LLMs and biorisk
items.summary: This article explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical element of responsible AI development.

items.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Cadences
items.summary: The latest Economic Index report looks at when people come to Claude, what they produce with it, and how they perceive AI's impact on their work.
